purpose: Paired larger-model replication of the fixed compact-head grid on addition.
selection: Minimum stored parameter count among EML heads with validation absolute MSE <= 0.005 and response MSE <= 0.005; otherwise best validation objective, explicitly marking the small-head threshold failure. Compare with validation-best EML, a neural control at the same rank/width, frozen rank32 heads, and sparse original neurons.
primary_test: Complete accuracy and four off-grid causal strengths across the three known prompt formats; paired operand-group uncertainty.
data_note: The additional 96 operand pairs are disjoint from all original 1.7B splits. They are shared with the smaller-model compact-head confirmation, which is already underway; this is a model replication, not another independent data sample.
